hooks.command: d="${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}"; b=node_modules/.bin/repo; [ -e "$d/$b" ] || [ -e "$d/$b.exe" ] || d="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "$d")"; r="$d/$b"; [ -e "$r" ] || [ ! -e "$r.exe" ] || r="$r.exe"; [ -x "$r" ] || { echo "repo: $d/$b is missing; run bun install" >&2; exit 1; }; "$r" hook orchestrate-parent
